PS1 BEDROOM v1.1

Time of day

Outside the window

Season

Weather

Type a city to sync the weather (and the sun's position) with the real world.
Live weather comes from Open-Meteo, a free weather service. Only the city name you type is sent to it. Refreshes every 20 minutes.
The weather drifts naturally on its own every 10-20 minutes, fitting the season.

Sky

Moon

Cinematic keeps the moon gliding low across your window all night. Real astronomy puts it exactly where it is in the sky (some nights it won't be up). Either way the phase matches tonight's real moon.

My Music

Pick music you own from your device: single songs, or a whole album folder (it reads the album, track order and cover art from the files or a cover.jpg). It plays through the boombox, is saved only on this device, and is never uploaded anywhere.
Mixer

Window

Tap the blinds (here or in the room) to cycle: slatted → tilted open → rolled all the way up → closed.

Lights

Appliances

Poster above the desk

Wall paint

Carpet

Bedsheets

Decorations

Auto puts up decorations for the time of year: Halloween in October, a little tree in December, hearts for Valentine's and a box fan in summer.
Almost everything in the room can be tapped directly too: the TV, the PlayStation and its buttons, the games on the shelves, the lamp, the boombox, the door and the light switch.

Quality

Frame rate

Look

PS1 effects (advanced)

Temperature

Sleep timer Off

Focus timer

Work in focused blocks with short breaks. The alarm clock by the bed counts down (green for work, blue for breaks) and a soft bell rings when it's time to switch.
When the timer runs out, every sound fades away over a minute and the room goes to sleep. On Android the sound keeps playing with the screen off or in other apps until then.

PS1 Bedroom

A little late-night room to keep you company. Real time, real sky, real weather, a PlayStation full of games, and a soundscape for every corner of the room.
Made by Daymion Gallo, aka Galloade, aka JenZiMiBruh.
